summary: Zoned Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a routine amendment to a real estate purchase and sale agreement. Its subsidiary, Chino Valley Properties, LLC, as seller, and 2148 Chino LLC amended the agreement for the buyer's property financing, allowing a lender to hold a promissory note or deed of trust. The property sale closed on September 2, 2026. This is an ordinary operational transaction with no material special-situation aspects, such as a strategic review or tender offer.
